text:
Maya R: Heads-up  candidate Kai Zhou onsite Mon 2026-08-03 09:00 PT. Ops asks: 1) pre-register with visa paperwork note, 2) temporary badge and escorted entry, 3) loaner Mac with corp VPN + Zoom, 4) parking validation and transit stipend details, 5) remote interviewer in Tokyo will call in at 00:00 JST (~08:00 PT) so AV check needed. Kai is vegetarian and needs gluten-free option.

Tom B: I can do escort. Meet at main lobby at 08:50?

Maya R: Yes please meet at main lobby and add escort name to prereg. Candidate will bring passport and DS-2019 (visa docs). FrontDeskBot, flag visa check on prereg.

FrontDeskBot: Pre-reg submitted. badge_ref=RV-6001. Flag: "visa paperwork" and "service: escort required". PDF uploaded to #people-ops-uploads. Please include escort Tom B on form.

IT Support: We have loaner-13 (MBA). Will image with VPN+Zoom and install corp certs. DM candidate email so I can pre-create account and test Zoom with Yuki. Imaging ETA 07:30.

Maya R: Email: kai.zhou+candidate@example.com. Also request quiet room for a feedback debrief 13:30-14:00.

RecruiterBot: Remote interviewer Yuki S (Tokyo) confirmed; Yuki needs a room with stable wired ethernet and AV mic.

Facilities: Reserving Conf B (wired) 07:45-09:15 PT for AV check and 08:45-09:30 for the interview. AV mic and Ethernet confirmed. We'll post a "scent-free" sign per candidate request.

Tom B: I'll pick up Kai at 08:50 and escort up. :wave:

IT Support: Imaging done 07:15. Username kai.zhou+candidate@example.com created. VPN and Zoom test with Yuki successful. Loaner assigned loaner-13.

Maya R: Travel reimbursements: if candidate paid travel, they can submit receipts to expenses@redwood.com with code CAND-INTL-2026. For transit, we offer a $40 stipend for local taxis; parking validation code: INTL-GATE.

FrontDeskBot: Badge printed. Escort assigned: Tom B. Parking spot reserved near visitor lot; validation INTL-GATE.

Yuki S: I'll join via Zoom at 00:00 JST (08:00 PT). Thanks for AV check  can someone DM me the meeting link?

Maya R: DMing link now. Also note: Kai prefers no strong fragrances in rooms. Catering please provide vegetarian + gluten-free boxed lunch labeled "Kai".

Facilities: Noted. Quiet room for debrief reserved Conf D 13:30-14:00. Signage placed.

Catering (automated): Lunch ordered: vegetarian + gluten-free box for Kai. Confirmation sent to Maya.

Tom B: Candidate confirmed arrival time and visa docs. He asked about where to claim transit stipend  I told him to bring receipts and we'll process after interview.

Maya R: Sounds good. Closing loop  reply here if any last-minute changes.

RecruiterBot: Interview calendar updated for panel. All participants invited (including remote Yuki).
